title: Starvation Assay
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rw9d7h6
materials: Mean time to death was recorded.

steps.title: Prepare Larvae Vials
steps.instruction: Collect 72 early third instar wandering female larvae from each mitotype and distribute them into 6 vials, with 12 larvae per vial.

steps.title: Set Up Humidity Control
steps.instruction: Place 6 x 3 cm pieces of filter paper wetted with ddH2O into each vial.

substeps.instruction: Add water twice daily to maintain humidity

steps.title: Monitor Larval Survival
steps.instruction: Observe larvae 5 times daily to determine if they are alive.

substeps.instruction: Use gentle prodding to check for viability
